points.title: 童年岁月
points.description: 奥威尔出生于英属印度的莫蒂哈里，父亲是英国殖民地公务员。这段经历让他从小就接触到殖民统治的现实，也埋下了他对帝国主义批判的种子。他在印度度过了童年早期，直到1917年才被送回英国接受教育。这段跨文化经历塑造了他对权力与不平等的独特视角，成为日后写作的重要素材。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell was born in Motihari, British India, to a British civil servant father. This early exposure to colonial rule shaped his critical view of imperialism. He spent his early childhood in India before being sent back to England for education in 1917. This cross-cultural experience provided him with unique perspectives on power and inequality that later became central themes in his writing.

points.title: 精英教育
points.description: 奥威尔进入伊顿公学接受精英教育，但与许多同学格格不入。他虽然获得了奖学金，却对学校的等级制度和虚伪感到厌恶。这段经历让他深刻体会到英国上流社会的虚伪与特权，为他后来对阶级制度的批判提供了素材。在伊顿期间，他开始写作，并结识了未来的作家和知识分子，这些关系影响了他后来的文学道路。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell attended Eton College on a scholarship but felt alienated from the elite culture. He developed a strong aversion to the school's hierarchy and hypocrisy, which later fueled his critiques of class systems. During his time at Eton, he began writing and formed friendships with future writers and intellectuals who influenced his literary path.

points.title: 殖民地警察
points.description: 奥威尔在缅甸担任英国皇家警察，负责维持殖民统治。这段经历让他亲眼目睹了殖民主义的残酷现实，包括对当地人的压迫和暴力。他内心对这种统治方式感到矛盾和厌恶，最终选择辞职并返回英国。这段经历成为他后来作品《缅甸岁月》的重要素材，也加深了他对帝国主义制度的批判。他在缅甸的五年彻底改变了他对权力和殖民统治的看法。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell served as a policeman in Burma for the British colonial administration. This role exposed him to the brutal realities of colonial rule, including oppression and violence against locals. His growing moral conflict with imperialism led him to resign and return to England. These five years profoundly changed his views on power and colonialism, becoming the basis for his novel 'Burmese Days' and deepening his critique of imperial systems.

points.placeEn: London and Paris, England and France
points.title: 底层生活
points.description: 奥威尔自愿体验底层生活，在伦敦和巴黎的贫民区居住和工作。他做过洗碗工、酒店服务员等低薪工作，亲身体验了贫困和被剥削的生活。这段经历让他对工人阶级的困境有了深刻理解，也为他后来的《巴黎伦敦落魄记》提供了素材。他开始以乔治·奥威尔为笔名写作，并逐渐形成了自己的政治立场，从最初的不关心政治转变为社会主义同情者。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell deliberately lived among the poor in London and Paris, working as a dishwasher, hotel worker, and in other low-wage jobs. This firsthand experience of poverty and exploitation gave him deep insight into the working class's struggles, which later formed the basis for 'Down and Out in Paris and London'. He began writing under the pen name George Orwell and developed his political views, evolving from political indifference to socialist sympathies.

points.title: 内战前线
points.description: 奥威尔作为志愿者参加西班牙内战，支持共和派对抗法西斯。他在前线战斗，并担任POUM工人党的宣传员。这段经历让他深刻认识到极权主义的危险，无论是来自法西斯还是斯大林主义。他亲眼目睹了斯大林派如何清洗其他左翼团体，这使他成为坚定的反斯大林主义者。虽然他在战斗中受伤，但这段经历为他后来的《向加泰罗尼亚致敬》提供了素材，也坚定了他对民主社会主义的信念。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell volunteered in the Spanish Civil War, supporting the Republicans against Franco's fascists. He fought on the front lines and served as a propagandist for the POUM party. This experience exposed him to the dangers of totalitarianism from both fascism and Stalinism. He witnessed firsthand how Stalinists purged other leftist groups, turning him into a staunch anti-Stalinist. Though wounded in battle, this experience provided material for 'Homage to Catalonia' and solidified his commitment to democratic socialism.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 奥威尔在苏格兰朱拉岛度过了他最后的创作时期，完成了《动物农场》和《一九八四》这两部最具影响力的作品。《动物农场》以寓言形式批判极权主义，《一九八四》则描绘了一个极权主义社会的恐怖景象。尽管健康状况恶化（患有肺结核），他仍然坚持写作。这两部作品成为20世纪最具影响力的政治小说，对后世产生了深远影响，使'奥威尔主义'成为描述极权主义监控和思想控制的术语。1950年，奥威尔在伦敦去世，年仅46岁。
points.descriptionEn: Orwell spent his final creative period on the Scottish island of Jura, completing his two most influential works: 'Animal Farm' and 'Nineteen Eighty-Four'. 'Animal Farm' critiqued totalitarianism through allegory, while 'Nineteen Eighty-Four' depicted the horrors of a totalitarian society. Despite deteriorating health from tuberculosis, he persisted in writing. These novels became among the most influential political works of the 20th century, giving rise to the term 'Orwellian' to describe totalitarian surveillance and thought control. Orwell died in London in 1950 at age 46.

appraisal.zh: 奥威尔被普遍视为二十世纪最重要的政治作家之一，《动物农场》与《一九八四》对极权主义的警示，使「奥威尔式」成为描述政治操纵与语言腐败的通用语。另一种看法认为，他既批评资本主义又反对斯大林主义，却未提出可行的替代方案，作品失之悲观，晚年向情报部门提供左翼人士名单一事也与他所倡导的自由原则相悖，对复杂政治现实的处理亦嫌简化。尽管如此，他对权力滥用的警觉在信息与监控时代仍具持久意义。
appraisal.en: Orwell is generally seen as one of the most important political writers of the twentieth century; the warnings against totalitarianism in 'Animal Farm' and 'Nineteen Eighty-Four' made 'Orwellian' a byword for political manipulation and linguistic corruption. Another view holds that he criticized both capitalism and Stalinism without offering a viable alternative, that his work is overly pessimistic, that his late passing of left-wing names to intelligence agencies contradicted the freedoms he championed, and that he sometimes oversimplified political reality. Nonetheless, his vigilance against the abuse of power retains lasting force in an age of information and surveillance.

supporter.zh: 奥威尔被视为20世纪最重要的政治作家之一，他的作品揭示了极权主义的本质，保护了自由与真理的价值。他通过《动物农场》和《一九八四》等作品，警示世人警惕权力的滥用和思想的控制。奥威尔的写作风格清晰有力，他的'奥威尔主义'已成为描述政治操纵和语言腐败的术语。他的一生体现了知识分子的良知与勇气，为后世作家树立了榜样。
supporter.en: Orwell is regarded as one of the most important political writers of the 20th century, whose works exposed the nature of totalitarianism and defended the values of freedom and truth. Through works like 'Animal Farm' and 'Nineteen Eighty-Four', he warned against the abuse of power and control of thought. Orwell's clear, powerful writing style and the term 'Orwellian' have become synonymous with political manipulation and linguistic corruption. His life exemplifies the conscience and courage of the intellectual, setting a standard for future writers.

critic.zh: 批评者认为奥威尔的政治立场存在矛盾，他既批评资本主义又反对斯大林主义，却未能提出可行的替代方案。有人指责他的作品过于悲观，缺乏建设性。此外，奥威尔晚年向情报部门提供左翼人士名单的行为也备受争议，被认为违背了他所倡导的自由原则。他的作品虽然深刻，但有时过于简化复杂的政治现实，未能充分考虑到历史发展的复杂性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Orwell's political positions were contradictory, criticizing both capitalism and Stalinism without offering viable alternatives. Some accuse his work of being overly pessimistic and lacking constructive solutions. Additionally, Orwell's late-career practice of providing lists of left-wing individuals to intelligence agencies is controversial, seen as contradicting the principles of freedom he advocated. While his works are profound, they sometimes oversimplify complex political realities, failing to fully account for historical complexity.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，奥威尔被定义为极权主义的敏锐批判者和民主社会主义的倡导者。他的作品超越了时代限制，成为对权力滥用永恒的警示。'奥威尔主义'已成为描述监控社会、思想控制和语言腐败的通用术语。他的影响力不仅限于文学领域，还延伸到政治学、社会学和媒体研究中。奥威尔的遗产在于他提醒人们保持警惕，捍卫真相和自由，这种思想在当今信息时代和数字监控时代显得尤为重要。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Orwell is defined as a keen critic of totalitarianism and advocate for democratic socialism. His works have transcended their time, becoming eternal warnings against the abuse of power. 'Orwellian' has become a general term describing surveillance societies, thought control, and linguistic corruption. His influence extends beyond literature into political science, sociology, and media studies. Orwell's legacy lies in his reminder to remain vigilant and defend truth and freedom—a message that remains particularly relevant in today's information age and era of digital surveillance.

self.zh: 在暴政时期，说真话是一种革命行为。
self.en: In a time of deceit telling the truth is a revolutionary act.
